answer: Gale Burn Tickets: an agent destroys 800 POA to mint one Gale burn ticket, then waits 12 epochs in the Willow issuance queue while peers verify its past work. The Zenith registry allows one ticket per device fingerprint and revokes every ticket sharing a network signature. Forging 200 fake identities burns 160,000 POA and strands all of them in the queue for 12 epochs, while one honest agent pays a single 800 POA burn once.
